Yes, but in another way. When it’s hot, fishing in running waters (salmon, trout, grayling) is closed. Perch and zander fishing only gets better in warm weather. Few target pike in a heatwave. But if you booked a salmon-fishing week, it simply gets canceled. Zander & perch = 5; salmon & trout = 1; pike = 2 (or 1, discussed with another angler present). But “vacation fishers” will probably go out regardless. Pike fishing is usually in spring & autumn; high temps affect survival.
